workflow: Referral fax intake: create patient with demographics + insurance, attach the referral PDF, book a new-patient appointment

setup.bullet: Log in to OpenEMR (admin — receptionist cannot open patient Documents)
setup.command: npx tsx oe.ts login --user admin --pass pass

steps.bullet: Create patient Rosa HACKDEMO-Alvarez-TR{{HHMMSS}}, DOB 03/14/1985, Female, phone 512-555-0111, 2210 Willowbend Dr, Austin TX 78745
steps.command: npx tsx oe.ts create-patient --lname 'HACKDEMO-Alvarez-TR{{HHMMSS}}' --fname 'Rosa' --dob 1985-03-14 --sex Female --phone '512-555-0111' --street '2210 Willowbend Dr' --city 'Austin' --st 'TX' --zip '78745'
steps.verify: npx tsx oe.ts verify-patient --lname 'HACKDEMO-Alvarez-TR{{HHMMSS}}' --fname 'Rosa' --dob 1985-03-14 --phone '512-555-0111' --street '2210 Willowbend Dr' --city 'Austin' --zip '78745'

steps.bullet: Add primary insurance Aekna, member AXX2650168, group GRP-56000
steps.command: npx tsx oe.ts add-insurance --lname 'HACKDEMO-Alvarez-TR{{HHMMSS}}' --carrier 'Aekna' --member-id 'AXX2650168' --group 'GRP-56000' --fname 'Rosa' --dob 1985-03-14 --sex Female --street '2210 Willowbend Dr' --city 'Austin' --st 'TX' --zip '78745'

steps.bullet: Attach referral-01.pdf to the patient's Documents
Book a New Patient appointment next weekday 09:00
steps.command: npx tsx oe.ts book-appt --lname 'HACKDEMO-Alvarez-TR{{HHMMSS}}' --date next-weekday --time 09:00 --category 'New Patient'
